verdict.rationale: Lovable documents its own MCP server, which lets an external AI agent create projects, send messages, inspect code and deploy apps without the Lovable UI. That is a genuine non-interactive control surface, but the evidence never shows a CLI, a CI integration, or a public REST API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Build with URL only opens the interactive editor, so it does not count as headless. missing for 10: documented CLI or headless runner, CI pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions), public API/OpenAPI spec with auth tokens for automation, hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: your AI agent can create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code, deploy apps, and more, all without leaving the client you're already working in
